title: AI runs the dungeon  - WIP alpha in your browser. Give me your 3-min verdict.
author: WelcomeMysterious122
selftext:
I’ve been building a roguelike-style dungeon crawler where an AI plays the role of the Dungeon Master. Right now it’s just the core loop: you pick a character, explore a small map, run into AI-generated events, make choices, and roll D20 checks to see how things play out. There’s simple inventory, basic stats, and a log so you can follow your journey.

This is **very** barebones - only one short story, placeholder UI, minimal balancing - but I want to make sure the fundamentals feel right before adding more stories, enemies, and mechanics. Think of it as the foundation for a multi-story roguelike where each run could have a completely different narrative.

It runs on Gemini’s free API for the AI DM, so if it suddenly stops generating, I’ve hit my daily quota (should work again later).

Looking for gut-level feedback:

* Does the map movement feel smooth and clear?
* Are the scenes, choices, and dice rolls easy to follow?
* Does anything feel too slow, confusing, or clunky?
* Any bugs or odd AI behavior?

Play here:  [here](https://storyforge-autodm-888660341707.us-west1.run.app/) \- takes 3 - 5 minutes to run through. Brutal honesty appreciated so I can nail the feel before layering in the rest or if its even worth putting in more effort on it.
